title: DayTimeBar
description: Displaying the time of day in the bossbar
body:
This plugin displays information about the time of day in the game. 
This makes it convenient to play and always know what time it is.

 It displays day night sunset sunrise.

tutorial config:

 enabled: true  - plugin state (on\off) (true\false)

 lang: ru_ru - plugin language (Russian\English) (ru_ru\en_en)

commands:

 /dtb toggle - turning the bossbar display on and off

 /dtb reload - reload plugin

permissions:

 dtb.admin - access to all commands
